read.thesis: Synchrony's Q3 shows record purchase volume ($49.7B, +8%) and charge-offs at 4.8%, but FY26 EPS at ~$9.50 high end rests on lower reserve build, with NIM and deposit-beta pressure ahead.

triggers.label: FY26 EPS ~$9.50, high end
triggers.quote: now expect to deliver approximately $9.50 in diluted earnings per share for the full year the high end of our original expectations.

triggers.label: Deposit betas to exceed past cycle
triggers.quote: betas will be higher than the pass rate hiking cycle given the competitive dynamics in the fight over deposits you are seeing today

triggers.label: Operational losses tail through year
triggers.quote: you do have a tail which has played through the entire year

triggers.label: Purchase volume +8% to $49.7B
triggers.quote: purchase volume grew 8% versus last year and reached almost $50 billion.

guidance.quote: now expect to deliver approximately $9.50 in diluted earnings per share for the full year the high end of our original expectations.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we began the year with the range of $9.10 to $9.50, right

red_flags.label: Deposit beta pressure ahead
red_flags.quote: betas will be higher than the pass rate hiking cycle given the competitive dynamics in the fight over deposits you are seeing today

red_flags.label: CET1 down 140 bps YoY
red_flags.quote: Synchrony ended the quarter with a CET1 ratio of 12.9% reflecting a 140 basis point reduction versus last year.

evasions.quote: we are not going to get into 2027 guidance on this call, Ryan
